name: SimpleAnimatedName
description: Creates an animated gradient text effect that responds to user interaction, allowing theme color changes through keyboard input.

props.name: name
props.description: The text to display with the animation effect

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the text element

usage: Use for creating eye-catching animated text with gradient effects
Interactive hover state indicates keyboard shortcuts are available
Press Space key while hovering to cycle through different theme colors
Press 'S' key while hovering to save the current color preference permanently
Supports both old and new theme systems for backward compatibility
Includes a helpful title tooltip explaining keyboard interactions
examples:
// With custom styling
<SimpleAnimatedName
  name="Portfolio"
  className="text-3xl font-bold"
/>
design: Animated gradient flows at 135 degrees (diagonal direction)
Uses application's primary and secondary colors from CSS variables (--color-base and --color-accent)
Continuous 6-second animation cycle with ease timing function
Background size set to 200% to enable the flowing effect
Smooth 0.3s transitions for all property changes
Uses CSS animation 'gradientMove' for the flowing effect (defined in global styles)
accessibility: Includes descriptive title tooltip: 'Press space to change colors when hovering, press 'S' to save your favorite color'
Cursor changes to pointer on hover to indicate interactivity
Provides fallback text color for browsers that don't support background-clip: text
Prevents default space key behavior to avoid page scrolling during interaction
